definitions.explanation: A formal term for someone who writes professionally, encompassing novelists, essayists, and other literary figures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文筆家|ぶんぴつか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: She is active as a writer.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{文筆家|ぶんぴつか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: A young writer is attracting attention.

examples.japanese: {文筆家|ぶんぴつか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{書|か}き{続|つづ}けている→書き続ける：29433_kakitsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: I keep writing every day, aiming to become a professional writer.

notes:
A formal compound meaning someone who writes for a living. Combines {文筆|ぶんぴつ} (writing, literary work) and ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional/expert). Covers a broad range of writing professions, not limited to fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文筆家|ぶんぴつか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{生計|せいけい}→生計：13524_seikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to make a living as a writer
- {文筆家|ぶんぴつか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{志|こころざ}す→志す：12569_kokorozasu⟧: to aspire to be a writer
- {文筆|ぶんぴつ}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: literary activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: author/novelist — the most common general term for writers, especially fiction
- ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧: author — emphasizes being the author of a specific work
- {物書|ものか}き: writer — informal/humble term for someone who writes
